recipes.name: Lemon & basil pasta
recipes.description: Bright lemon, fresh basil, and a silky sauce. A little sunshine in a bowl.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to its package instructions. Reserve 120 ml of cooking water before draining.
Warm the olive oil in a large pan over low heat. Add the lemon juice and half the reserved water.
Add the drained pasta and toss for 1–2 minutes. Turn off the heat, then fold in the Parmesan, adding the remaining water a little at a time to make a silky sauce.
Tear in the basil, season to taste, and serve straight away.
recipes.notes: Add cheese off the heat so it melts gently. Pasta water is a process aid; use only enough to loosen the sauce.
recipes.imageAlt: A bowl of pasta with green herbs

recipes.name: Tomato & basil bruschetta
recipes.description: Crunchy toast topped with juicy tomatoes, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil.
steps: Dice the tomatoes and place in a bowl. Tear the basil and stir it into the tomatoes with half the olive oil.
Toast the bread until crisp on both sides, using a dry pan or a toaster.
Cut the garlic clove in half and gently rub the cut side across the warm toast.
Spoon over the tomato mixture, drizzle with the remaining oil, season to taste, and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Add the topping just before serving to keep the bread crisp. Choose vegan bread if following the sample vegan tag.
recipes.imageAlt: Toast topped with diced tomatoes and fresh herbs

recipes.name: Creamy mushroom risotto
recipes.description: Golden mushrooms and tender rice for a slow, comforting evening.
steps: Warm the stock in a small saucepan. Slice the mushrooms and finely chop the onion.
Melt half the butter in a wide pan. Brown the mushrooms, remove to a plate, then soften the onion in the same pan.
Stir in the rice. Add warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring and allowing each addition to absorb before the next. Continue until the rice is tender, about 20–25 minutes.
Fold in the mushrooms, remaining butter, and cheese. Season to taste and let stand for 2 minutes before serving.
recipes.notes: Use a vegetarian cheese if desired. Stock absorption varies; add a splash of water if the rice needs more time.
recipes.imageAlt: A warm rice dish with savoury toppings

recipes.name: Garden caprese salad
recipes.description: Ripe tomatoes, soft mozzarella, and basil. Simple things, beautifully together.
steps: Wash the tomatoes and basil. Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella into even pieces.
Arrange the tomatoes and cheese on a serving plate, alternating them as you go.
Scatter the basil over the plate. Whisk together the olive oil and vinegar, then drizzle on top.
Season to taste and serve at once, preferably at room temperature.
recipes.notes: Let chilled tomatoes stand briefly before serving for fuller flavour.
recipes.imageAlt: A colourful mixed vegetable salad

recipes.name: The feel-good rainbow bowl
recipes.description: A bright mix of grains, crunchy vegetables, and a lemon-tahini dressing.
steps: Rinse the quinoa. Add it to a saucepan with water according to its package instructions, cook until tender, and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Rinse and drain the chickpeas. Slice the cucumber and tomatoes, and grate the carrot.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and a little water until pourable. Season to taste.
Divide the quinoa and greens between bowls. Arrange the vegetables and chickpeas on top, drizzle with dressing, and enjoy.
recipes.notes: Use different coloured vegetables for variety. Tahini can thicken with lemon; add water gradually.
recipes.imageAlt: A colourful bowl of fresh vegetables, chickpeas and greens

recipes.name: Everyday Greek salad
recipes.description: Crisp cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and feta with a lively oregano dressing.
steps: Wash the vegetables. Cut the cucumber and tomatoes into bite-sized chunks, and thinly slice the onion.
Place the vegetables and olives in a large bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil, add oregano, and toss gently. Taste before adding salt because feta and olives are salty.
Crumble the feta over the top and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Keep the dressing separate if preparing the vegetables ahead.
recipes.imageAlt: Leafy salad with colourful fresh vegetables

recipes.name: Lemon hummus & warm pita
recipes.description: Creamy chickpea hummus with warm bread and crunchy vegetable sticks.
steps: Drain the chickpeas, reserving some liquid. Peel the garlic and cut the cucumber into sticks.
Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil until smooth. Add reserved chickpea liquid a spoonful at a time to reach your preferred texture.
Warm the pita in a dry pan and cut into wedges.
Spoon hummus onto a plate, season to taste, and serve with the warm pita and cucumber sticks.
recipes.notes: The liquid is added to texture rather than a fixed quantity; keep it out of the scaling calculation.
recipes.imageAlt: A bowl of creamy hummus with chickpeas, herbs and oil

recipes.name: Avocado & soft scrambled eggs
recipes.description: Soft eggs and buttery avocado on golden toast. A gentler start to the day.
steps: Toast the bread. Halve and mash the avocado with the lemon juice.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk together.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat. Add the eggs and stir gently until softly set and cooked through.
Spread avocado onto the toast, spoon over the eggs, season to taste, and serve warm.
recipes.notes: Scaled whole ingredients may appear fractional. Measure beaten eggs by proportion or round practical counts thoughtfully.
recipes.imageAlt: A plated breakfast with toast and eggs

recipes.name: Ginger chicken rice bowl
recipes.description: Fragrant ginger chicken, fluffy rice, and crisp cucumber for a cosy dinner.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with water according to its package instructions.
Slice the chicken into even strips. Peel and grate the ginger, then combine it with the soy sauce and chicken.
Heat the oil in a frying pan. Cook the chicken, turning regularly, until completely cooked through.
Slice the cucumber and serve alongside the chicken and rice. Spoon the hot pan juices over the bowl.
recipes.notes: Keep raw chicken separate from ready-to-eat vegetables. The sample soy sauce contains wheat.
recipes.imageAlt: A prepared bowl with colourful vegetables

recipes.name: Fresh garden rice paper rolls
recipes.description: Fresh herbs and crisp vegetables wrapped in delicate rice paper.
steps: Cook the vermicelli according to its package instructions, rinse with cool water, and drain.
Cut the carrot and cucumber into fine strips. Wash and dry the lettuce and mint.
Soften one rice paper sheet at a time in lukewarm water. Place vegetables, noodles, and mint near the lower edge; fold in the sides and roll snugly.
Mix soy sauce and lime juice in a small dipping bowl. Serve the rolls immediately with the dipping sauce.
recipes.notes: Use a damp board to prevent the wrappers sticking. Fractional sheets from scaling are mathematical estimates.
recipes.imageAlt: Fresh rice paper rolls with colourful vegetables and dipping sauce

recipes.name: Lemongrass tofu bánh mì
recipes.description: Golden tofu, quick tangy vegetables, and fragrant herbs in a crisp baguette.
steps: Cut the carrot into thin strips and toss with rice vinegar. Slice the cucumber and finely chop the tender lemongrass centre.
Pat the tofu dry, slice it, and coat with soy sauce and lemongrass.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the tofu until golden on both sides.
Split the baguettes. Fill with hot tofu, drained carrot, and cucumber. Season to taste and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Pressing excess moisture from tofu helps it brown. Use dairy-free baguettes for the sample vegan version.
recipes.imageAlt: A filled Vietnamese baguette with fresh herbs and vegetables

recipes.name: Banana coconut breakfast bowl
recipes.description: Warm coconut oats with banana for a simple, satisfying morning.
steps: Combine oats, coconut milk, and water in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Slice the bananas. Mash half into the oats and reserve the rest for topping.
Divide into bowls, top with the remaining banana and toasted coconut, and serve warm.
recipes.notes: This is an original sample inspired by coconut flavours, not a claim of a traditional Vietnamese dish.
recipes.imageAlt: A breakfast bowl topped with fruit

recipes.name: Sticky teriyaki tofu bowl
recipes.description: Crisp tofu and tender broccoli with a glossy homemade teriyaki glaze.
steps: Cook the rice according to its package instructions. Cut the broccoli into small florets and steam until tender.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into cubes. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the tofu until golden.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar. Add to the tofu and simmer briefly until the glaze coats the cubes.
Divide rice and broccoli between bowls. Add the glazed tofu and finish with sesame seeds.
recipes.notes: Reduce the glaze gently; it thickens more as it cools.
recipes.imageAlt: A prepared bowl with tofu, vegetables and eggs, illustrating a rice bowl style

recipes.name: Miso mushroom noodle soup
recipes.description: A savoury mushroom broth with noodles, greens, and mellow white miso.
steps: Slice the mushrooms and tofu. Wash and chop the pak choi.
Bring the vegetable stock to a simmer. Add the mushrooms and tofu and cook for 5 minutes.
Cook the noodles according to their package instructions. Add the greens to the broth for the final 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat. Dissolve miso in a little hot broth, stir it back into the pot, and serve over the drained noodles.
recipes.notes: Add miso after turning off the heat to preserve its delicate aroma. Check that the miso contains no fish stock.
recipes.imageAlt: A steaming bowl of noodle soup

recipes.name: Sesame cucumber onigiri
recipes.description: Little rice parcels with sesame and cucumber. Perfect for a quiet snack.
steps: Rinse and cook the sushi rice according to its package instructions. Stir in rice vinegar and let cool until safe to handle.
Finely dice the cucumber and pat dry. Cut the nori into strips.
With clean, slightly damp hands, shape portions of warm rice around small amounts of cucumber. Make compact triangles or rounds.
Press sesame seeds onto the surface, wrap with strips of nori, and serve.
recipes.notes: Freshly shaped rice holds together best. The image is an illustrative Japanese-style rice dish.
recipes.imageAlt: A Japanese-style rice dish with a savoury topping

recipes.name: Cabbage breakfast pancakes
recipes.description: Golden savoury cabbage pancakes with a simple soy drizzle.
steps: Finely shred the cabbage and slice the spring onion.
Whisk flour, eggs, and water into a batter. Fold in cabbage and spring onion.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Spoon in the mixture to make small pancakes and cook on both sides until golden and set through the centre.
Serve warm with a light drizzle of soy sauce and seasoning to taste.
recipes.notes: Make smaller pancakes for easier turning. These are a simplified educational interpretation of okonomiyaki.
recipes.imageAlt: A stack of golden pancakes on a plate

recipes.name: Golden chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.description: A gently spiced tomato curry full of chickpeas, spinach, and comfort.
steps: Finely chop the onion. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat the oil in a saucepan and soften the onion. Stir in the curry powder and cook for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas, and coconut milk. Simmer gently for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Fold in the spinach until wilted. Season to taste and serve in bowls.
recipes.notes: Rice or bread is an optional accompaniment and is not included in the ingredient calculation.
recipes.imageAlt: A warmly coloured curry in a serving bowl

recipes.name: Everyday red lentil dal
recipes.description: Soft red lentils, warming spices, and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Rinse the lentils until the water runs mostly clear. Finely chop the onion and tomato.
Heat the oil in a saucepan, soften the onion, and add cumin and turmeric.
Stir in the tomato, lentils, and water. Simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring regularly, until the lentils are soft. Add a little extra water if needed.
Stir in the lemon juice, season to taste, and ladle into bowls.
recipes.notes: Lentils thicken as they stand. Add a splash of water when reheating to restore a spoonable texture.
recipes.imageAlt: A selection of Indian-style dishes in bowls

recipes.name: Masala potato toast
recipes.description: Crisp toast piled with warmly spiced potato and fresh tomato.
steps: Peel and dice the potatoes. Boil in water until tender, then drain.
Finely chop onion and tomato. Heat the oil in a pan and soften the onion with cumin.
Add the tomato and cooked potato. Mash lightly in the pan and cook for 3–4 minutes.
Toast the bread and spoon the spiced potato mixture on top. Season to taste and serve warm.
recipes.notes: Smaller potato cubes cook faster. The total preparation time includes boiling.
recipes.imageAlt: Toast topped with diced tomatoes and fresh herbs

recipes.name: Cooling cucumber raita
recipes.description: Thick yogurt, cucumber, mint, and toasted cumin for a cooling side.
steps: Grate the cucumber and gently squeeze out excess moisture.
Whisk the yogurt in a bowl until smooth.
Finely chop the mint. Fold mint, cucumber, and cumin into the yogurt.
Season to taste and serve chilled.
recipes.notes: The photograph illustrates a yogurt-style dip rather than an exact finished raita.
recipes.imageAlt: A bowl of creamy hummus with chickpeas, herbs and oil

recipes.name: Weeknight black bean tacos
recipes.description: Warm tortillas, smoky beans, and a fresh crunch. Weeknight happiness.
steps: Rinse and drain the beans. Dice the tomatoes and slice the avocado.
Heat the oil in a pan. Add the cumin and beans with a splash of water; cook for 5 minutes and mash some beans lightly.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan on both sides.
Fill the tortillas with beans, tomato, and avocado. Add lime juice and seasoning to taste.
recipes.notes: Check tortilla labels for wheat or other allergens; the sample uses corn-only tortillas.
recipes.imageAlt: Soft tacos with vegetables and fresh garnishes

recipes.name: Roasted corn quinoa salad
recipes.description: Sweet corn, fluffy quinoa, and a punchy lime dressing.
steps: Cook the quinoa according to its package instructions, then fluff with a fork.
Heat half the oil in a frying pan and cook the corn until lightly golden.
Dice the tomato and rinse the beans. Combine with quinoa and roasted corn.
Whisk lime juice with the remaining oil, pour over the salad, season to taste, and toss gently.
recipes.notes: Serve warm or allow the quinoa to cool before combining for a cold salad.
recipes.imageAlt: A colourful mixed vegetable salad

recipes.name: Spinach breakfast quesadilla
recipes.description: A crisp tortilla filled with eggs, spinach, and a little melting cheese.
steps: Beat the eggs. Wash the spinach and grate the cheese.
Heat half the oil in a pan. Wilt the spinach, add the eggs, and gently scramble until cooked through. Transfer to a bowl.
Place a tortilla in the pan, add half the cheese and egg mixture to one side, and fold over. Cook until golden on both sides. Repeat with the other tortilla.
Cut into wedges, season to taste, and serve hot.
recipes.notes: Cook on medium heat so the cheese melts before the tortilla browns too much.
recipes.imageAlt: A savoury tortilla dish with colourful fillings

recipes.name: Smoky vegetable fajita bowl
recipes.description: Colourful peppers, warm spices, and hearty beans over fluffy rice.
steps: Cook the rice according to its package instructions. Slice the onion and peppers into thin strips.
Heat the oil in a wide pan. Fry the onion and peppers over medium-high heat until softened and lightly charred.
Add smoked paprika and drained beans. Stir for 3–4 minutes until heated through.
Spoon the vegetables and beans over the rice, add lime juice, and season to taste.
recipes.notes: Keep the pan uncrowded so the peppers brown. Use two batches for larger serving counts.
recipes.imageAlt: A colourful bowl of fresh vegetables, chickpeas and greens

contributors.name: Linh Nguyen
contributors.background: A fictional home cook who finds inspiration in Vietnamese markets and Japanese comfort food.
contributors.bio: Linh is a fictional contributor who loves the contrast of crisp vegetables, soft rice, and fragrant herbs. Her sample recipes bring approachable Vietnamese-inspired flavours and simple Japanese-style meals to a busy everyday kitchen.

contributors.name: Maya Kapoor
contributors.background: A fictional recipe enthusiast with a love of warming spices and colourful Mediterranean tables.
contributors.bio: Maya is a fictional contributor inspired by the comfort of lentils, the warmth of spices, and the freshness of a generous salad. Her sample dishes make vegetables and pantry staples the heart of the meal.

contributors.name: Luca Romano
contributors.background: A fictional home cook exploring Italian classics and relaxed Mexican-inspired weeknight meals.
contributors.bio: Luca is a fictional contributor who believes a few good ingredients can create a very happy table. His sample recipes range from lemony pasta to quick tacos, always with an emphasis on relaxed, approachable cooking.
